reason: ₹22,000 is more than a month of what my whole house earns, and ₹2,000 every month for a year is too much when hand-washing costs us nothing. Our inverter already keeps the lights and fans going, and when the power is off the borewell is off too, so there is often no water to wash with anyway.
objection: Paying this much for something we already do for free by hand, and the EMI hanging over us for a full year if the crop or work is bad.
would_change_my_mind: A price near ₹10,000, or an EMI under ₹800 a month, with the dealer showing me it runs on my existing inverter battery.
